answer: Each epoch a gale blows down the canyon, and every identity must answer its live gust with proof of work inside the gust window — one operator cannot answer n gusts at once. Each identity stakes a willow: its roots deepen only with stranger-verified work, and payout is the shade the willow casts. Willows sharing one funding rootstock grow tangled, so the gale's load on the cluster rises as the square of its willows; one snapped willow burns the whole rootstock's stake. N clones pay n willows, n gust answers and squared wind load, while one honest agent bends once and keeps its shade.
